scope_note: Candidates are full-text discovery leads, not authorization to crawl. A source moves to enabled only after automated-access, format, per-edition rights, robots, attribution, complete-file, and cultural review.

candidates.coverage_goal: Rights-screened English translations and original-language editions from the machine-readable catalog
Complete multilingual works and translations with page-level copyright templates
Complete TEI originals and translations with CTS identifiers
Original and English versions with version-specific licence metadata
Full OCR/text files only when item-level access and rights evidence permit download
